descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S21 Visual lane on both task screens: axe, phone widths and WebKit Copy Text (and the Send dialog once built)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U7 The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, pixel7 (Chromium) and iphone15 (WebKit), android-lane on the emulator; two open and one completed task per context, completed section expanded, plus a 120-character task and a long patient name

When Visual lane runs axe-core and the layout checks on /rounding/tasks and /snf/tasks; taps Copy Text on WebKit and Chromium and reads the clipboard

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the icon-only 'mark done' and 'undo' buttons have accessible names; completed state is not shown by colour or strike-through alone; names, rooms/units and task texts wrap rather than truncate or overflow; Copy Text (and Send) are tap targets of at least 24 px; the WebKit clipboard text equals the Chromium one

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical; visual-lane findings covered / overflow / truncated / tap = 0 on the task screens (findings go to a human); WebKit clipboard equals Chromium clipboard. Accessible names and the completed-state wording read from the S01 / S02 snapshots once they run

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (web); Source: dev.

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S21

Visual lane on both task screens: axe, phone widths and WebKit Copy Text (and the Send dialog once built)

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr); TFA-92586 Handoff Summary: in app (ready for pr)
